description: This Java class provides functionality to deserialize JSON objects into instances of CommandResponse or its subclasses, focusing on extracting common fields and delegating specific object creation to a factory method.

classes.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A generic helper class to deserialize JSON into command response objects, checking the response type and extracting status-related information.

classes.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer.FactoryMethodFunction
classes.description: A functional interface used as a factory to create instances of CommandResponse based on deserialized data.

methods.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer(final String type, final JsonObject jsonObject)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deserializer with a JSON object and the expected command response type.

methods.name: CommandResponseJsonDeserializer(final String type, final String jsonString)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a JSON object from a string and initializes the deserializer.

methods.name: deserialize(final FactoryMethodFunction<T> factoryMethodFunction)
methods.description: Deserializes the JSON, verifies the response type, extracts the HTTP status code, and creates the command response object using the provided factory method.

methods.name: validateCommandResponseType()
methods.description: Checks if the actual command response type in the JSON matches the expected type; throws exception if not.
